Definition: middle voice from G1909 and G1614; to stretch (oneself) forward upon:--reach forth.
BiblicalUsage: Epekteinomai means to stretch oneself forward, reaching forth. Paul says he forgets what is behind and reaches forth to what is before, pressing toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
TheologicalSignificance: Not leaning back on yesterday but stretched forward toward Christ, who is ahead of me — that is the Christian posture, I believe.
